text: {"lessons":["I don’t need to trade every month; the account grew during periods when I made no trades, so I should wait for a clear reason to act.","Selling Stock B above my average cost was a realized gain, but one profitable sale doesn’t prove I can time the market; I should decide in advance what would make me sell.","I added to Stocks C and D after their prices had risen from my earlier purchases. Before adding, I should reassess the risks and keep my holdings diversified rather than buy simply because prices are moving up."]}
